segments.sn17.4:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.4:1.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanaṃ paviseyya.
segments.sn17.4:1.4: Sā tatra tatra sajjeyya, tatra tatra gayheyya [gaccheyya (sī.), gaṇheyya (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], tatra tatra bajjheyya, tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.sn17.4:1.5: ‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
segments.sn17.4:1.6: So tatra tatra sajjati, tatra tatra gayhati, tatra tatra bajjhati, tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn17.4:1.7: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban’”ti.
